supplements.title: Pharmacokinetic studies and synergistic antitumor effects of cannabichromene and cannabidiol in drug-resistant breast cancers.
supplements.summary: Cannabichromene and cannabidiol combined effectively inhibit drug-resistant triple-negative breast cancer by reducing tumor growth and blocking key cancer-promoting pathways.

supplements.title: Inhibition of Antioxidant Genes Expression in Echinococcus Granulosus by Baicalein: Implications for Novel Antiparasitic Strategies.
supplements.summary: Baicalein effectively inhibits antioxidant gene expression in Echinococcus granulosus parasites, offering a potential alternative to traditional hydatid cyst treatments.

supplements.title: Phytochemical and pharmacological elucidation of Jasonia glutinosa (L.) fourr. essential oil: a promising therapeutic source against inflammation and cancer.
supplements.summary: Jasonia glutinosa essential oil showed selective cytotoxicity against multiple cancer cell lines, particularly breast and liver cancer, while demonstrating strong anti-inflammatory properties.

supplements.title: Ginkgetin inhibits non-small cell lung cancer via the HSP90-AKT signaling pathway.
supplements.summary: Ginkgetin, a natural compound from Ginkgo biloba, inhibits non-small cell lung cancer cell growth by targeting the HSP90-AKT signaling pathway.

supplements.title: Five daucane-type sesquiterpenes isolated from the roots of Ferula songarica Pall. ex Schult. and their anti-gastric cancer activity.
supplements.summary: Researchers discovered three potent compounds from Ferula songarica roots that effectively inhibit gastric cancer cell growth in laboratory tests.

supplements.title: Modulating the gut-reproductive tract axis: microbial influence on gynaecological cancer pathogenesis and treatment.
supplements.summary: Gut microbiota composition significantly influences ovarian, endometrial, and cervical cancer development, progression, and treatment response through immune and metabolic mechanisms.

supplements.title: Multifunctional drug delivery of nanofibrous iron-polyphenolic nanochelates improved photothermal therapy against colorectal cancer via ferroptosis.
supplements.summary: Nanofibrous iron-polyphenolic nanochelates enhanced photothermal therapy for colorectal cancer by improving ferroptosis and triggering an immune response.

supplements.title: Natural exosome-like nanovesicles from Smilax China rhizome induce mitophagy-dependent ferroptosis in hepatocellular carcinoma via GPX4/ACSL4 axis.
supplements.summary: Natural nanovesicles from a Chinese medicinal plant trigger a specific type of cell death in liver cancer by targeting mitochondrial processes.

supplements.title: Comparative in vitro cytotoxicity of free curcumin and a liposomal curcumin formulation on various human cancer cell lines.
supplements.summary: Liposomal curcumin significantly improved cancer cell death across multiple cancer types, showing enhanced cytotoxicity compared to free curcumin while sparing normal cells.

supplements.title: Quaternized Chitosan-Ferulic Acid-Based Nanomicelles for Dimethoxycurcumin Delivery and Synergistic Colorectal Adenocarcinoma Therapy with 5-Fluorouracil.
supplements.summary: Nanomicelles loaded with dimethoxycurcumin enhanced colorectal cancer cell death when combined with 5-fluorouracil, showing selective tumor targeting and reduced toxicity.

supplements.title: Formulation and characterization of pH-sensitive double emulsion sodium alginate/polyvinyl alcohol/graphene quantum dot for efficient quercetin delivery to A549 cells.
supplements.summary: A novel nanocarrier system using sodium alginate, graphene quantum dots, and quercetin showed enhanced targeted delivery and anticancer effects in lung cancer cells.

supplements.title: Naringenin roled octacalcium phosphate reinforced with polyvinyl alcohol composite for sarcoma affected bone repair.
supplements.summary: A naringenin-enhanced calcium phosphate composite showed promising potential for bone repair and cancer cell suppression in osteosarcoma, increasing stem cell survival and inhibiting cancer cell growth.

supplements.title: Hormonal rewiring of immunity during dietary restriction ensures host defense and systemic glucose conservation.
supplements.summary: Glucocorticoid hormones help the immune system adapt to food scarcity by balancing pathogen defense and glucose conservation.

supplements.title: Does GABA supplementation modulate muscle cytokine expression and inflammatory status in aged rats?
supplements.summary: GABA supplementation reduced inflammatory markers in aged rats' muscle tissues, potentially mitigating age-related inflammatory processes.

supplements.title: Pyridinium alkaloids - a unique class of naturally occurring salt-form secondary metabolites: a comprehensive review of 68 years (1958-mid-2025).
supplements.summary: Certain marine sponge-derived pyridinium alkaloids, like coscinoderines, show potential for selectively killing nutrient-deprived cancer cells.

off_label.title: SAICAR Drives T Regulatory Cell Differentiation and FOXP3 Maintenance to Promote Immunotherapy Resistance.
off_label.summary: SAICAR, a metabolite, promotes suppressive T cells in tumors, blocking immunotherapy effectiveness and suggesting a potential treatment strategy.

off_label.title: Inhibition of Antioxidant Genes Expression in Echinococcus Granulosus by Baicalein: Implications for Novel Antiparasitic Strategies.
off_label.summary: Baicalein effectively inhibits antioxidant gene expression in Echinococcus granulosus parasites, offering a potential alternative to traditional hydatid cyst treatments.

off_label.title: Exploring FDA-approved small molecules for their potential as PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors: integrating computational screening with experimental testing.
off_label.summary: Researchers used computational screening to identify FDA-approved small molecules that could potentially block PD-1/PD-L1 interactions and enhance cancer immunotherapy.

off_label.title: Targeting ERLIN1 reveals a coordinated cholesterol-dependent vulnerability in hepatocellular carcinoma.
off_label.summary: Researchers discovered that targeting the ERLIN1 protein disrupts cholesterol regulation in liver cancer cells, potentially offering a new treatment approach.

off_label.title: The NADPH oxidase inhibitor Vas2870 prevents myocyte ferroptosis and improves cardiac remodelling and function in doxorubicin-induced cardiomyopathy.
off_label.summary:
Here's a clear, concise summary sentence:

Blocking NADPH oxidase with Vas2870 prevented heart muscle cell death and improved cardiac function in mice treated with the cancer drug doxorubicin.

off_label.title: Quaternized Chitosan-Ferulic Acid-Based Nanomicelles for Dimethoxycurcumin Delivery and Synergistic Colorectal Adenocarcinoma Therapy with 5-Fluorouracil.
off_label.summary: Nanomicelles loaded with dimethoxycurcumin enhanced colorectal cancer cell death when combined with 5-fluorouracil, showing selective tumor targeting and reduced toxicity.

off_label.title: Exploring synergistic therapeutic potential of Erlotinib and artemisinin in non-small cell lung Cancer (NSCLC) using pharmacological networking and mathematical modeling.
off_label.summary:
Here's a clear, concise summary sentence:

Combining Erlotinib and artemisinin shows promise for overcoming treatment resistance and improving therapeutic outcomes in non-small cell lung cancer.

off_label.title: Dimethyl fumarate as an immunomodulatory enhancer of adipose-derived mesenchymal stem cells: therapeutic implications.
off_label.summary: Dimethyl fumarate enhances adipose-derived stem cells' immunomodulatory properties, potentially improving their therapeutic effectiveness in inflammatory conditions.

off_label.title: Integrated transcriptomic and methylome analysis reveals retinoic acid pathway activation after decitabine treatment in EBV-associated gastric cancer.
off_label.summary:
Here's a clear, concise summary sentence focusing on the key finding:

Decitabine treatment in Epstein-Barr virus-associated gastric cancer reactivates the retinoic acid signaling pathway by reducing DNA methylation.

off_label.title: Proteomic insights into Helicobacter pylori infection in stomach cells, revealing host response and host-targeted therapeutics repurposing.
off_label.summary: Researchers identified how stomach cells respond to H. pylori infection, potentially revealing new treatment strategies for gastric cancer by understanding host protein changes.

off_label.title: Melatonin suppresses glycolysis and coordinately disrupts DNA repair via targeting the YAP1-NAMPT signaling in breast cancer.
off_label.summary: Melatonin suppresses glycolysis and DNA repair in triple-negative breast cancer by targeting YAP1-NAMPT signaling, potentially enhancing cancer treatment effectiveness.

off_label.title: Streptomycin mitigates methylglyoxal-induced carbonyl stress through its antiglycation activity: A drug-repurposing approach for carbonyl stress-related disorder.
off_label.summary: Streptomycin showed promise in reducing harmful protein modifications caused by methylglyoxal in neuroblastoma cells, suggesting potential therapeutic use in carbonyl stress-related disorders.

off_label.title: Valproic acid reverses macrophage-mediated temozolomide resistance in macrophage-rich gliomas.
off_label.summary: Valproic acid helps reverse drug resistance in gliomas by transforming tumor-associated macrophages, potentially improving temozolomide treatment effectiveness.

off_label.title: PEGylated Heterofunctional Dendrimers Enable Multivalent Diclofenac Delivery for ROS-Driven Anticancer Activity.
off_label.summary: PEGylated dendrimers significantly enhanced diclofenac's anticancer effectiveness by improving drug delivery and increasing reactive oxygen species in multiple cancer cell lines.

off_label.title: Statins halt polycystic liver disease by reprogramming metabolism and normalizing mitochondrial bioenergetics in cystic cholangiocytes.
off_label.summary: Statins can potentially treat polycystic liver disease by correcting mitochondrial and metabolic dysfunction in liver cells, offering a promising non-surgical intervention.

biomarkers.title: Brain Network Patterns in Patients With Multiple System Atrophy: Spatial Independent Component Analysis Using FDG-PET Data.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers used advanced brain imaging to map unique metabolic network patterns in multiple system atrophy, potentially improving understanding of this complex neurodegenerative disease.

biomarkers.title: Follow the 'DOTs': Vδ1+ γδ T cells as effectors of cancer immunotherapy.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers propose leveraging Vδ1+ γδ T cells, particularly delta one T (DOT) cells, as a promising new approach to expand cancer immunotherapy's effectiveness across more tumor types.

biomarkers.title: Intravenous infusion of engineered megakaryocytes to produce oncolytic platelets in vivo for enhanced cancer immunotherapy.
biomarkers.summary: Engineered megakaryocytes delivering oncolytic viruses via platelets can effectively target and suppress lung and colorectal cancer metastases while enhancing immune response.

biomarkers.title: E711-19 placement and orientation dictate CD8+ T cell response in structurally defined spherical nucleic acid vaccines.
biomarkers.summary: In a targeted HPV vaccine study, specific nanostructure design enhanced T cell response and reduced tumor burden by optimizing antigen placement.

biomarkers.title: Efficacy and Safety of Neoadjuvant Immunochemotherapy for Locally Advanced Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma: A Meta-Analysis.
biomarkers.summary: A combination of immunotherapy and chemotherapy before surgery shows promising results for improving treatment outcomes in advanced head and neck cancer patients.

biomarkers.title: [Application of a novel robot-assisted navigation system in CT-guided percutaneous lung biopsy].
biomarkers.summary: A robot-assisted navigation system significantly improved CT-guided lung biopsy by reducing procedure time, needle adjustments, and CT scans while minimizing bleeding complications.

biomarkers.title: Specific detection of EGF-EGFR complexes on the cell surface and their dependency on EGFR-directed TKI treatment.
biomarkers.summary: A new method using ActE_21 reveals that EGFR-targeted drugs can increase EGF-EGFR complexes on the cell surface in some lung and breast cancer cell lines.

biomarkers.title: Haploinsufficiency of MBD5 and MBD6 impairs mitochondrial respiration through chromatin-mediated gene regulation.
biomarkers.summary: MBD5 and MBD6 gene deficiency impairs mitochondrial function in neuroblastoma cells by disrupting mitochondrial gene expression and cellular metabolism.

biomarkers.title: Metabolic positron emission tomography imaging and tumor growth inhibition during the Q neuron-induced hibernation-like state in mice.
biomarkers.summary: In mice, artificially induced hibernation significantly reduced tumor growth by lowering glucose metabolism and altering nutrient distribution in the body.

biomarkers.title: Multi-scale transcriptomics analysis reveals MHC suppression in MEF2D fusion positive B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia.
biomarkers.summary: In MEF2D fusion B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia, single-cell analysis revealed reduced MHC expression, potentially enabling cancer cells to evade immune detection.

biomarkers.title: Tubulin α-1C chain as a central signalling hub in carcinogenesis: Towards a conceptual framework.
biomarkers.summary: TUBA1C protein is consistently overexpressed across multiple cancer types, promoting tumor progression, metastasis, and treatment resistance through diverse signaling pathways.

biomarkers.title: Genomic and immune landscape of parthanatos in breast carcinoma: The central role of AIFM1.
biomarkers.summary: A new study reveals how a specific cell death pathway called parthanatos may impact breast cancer progression through the protein AIFM1.

biomarkers.title: Magnetic nanoparticles for cancer theranostics.
biomarkers.summary: Magnetic nanoparticles show promise in cancer treatment by enabling targeted therapies, precise imaging, and personalized diagnostic approaches across multiple cancer types.

biomarkers.title: Selective multimodal deep learning for reliable breast cancer subtype classification from histopathology and genomic data.
biomarkers.summary: A multimodal deep learning approach combining histology and genomic data achieves 94.93% accuracy in classifying breast cancer subtypes with improved computational efficiency.

biomarkers.title: Prognostic Model Combining Mutational and Cytogenetic Profiles in Acute Myeloid Leukemia Treated with Venetoclax and Hypomethylating Agents.
biomarkers.summary: A genetic risk model for acute myeloid leukemia patients treated with venetoclax and hypomethylating agents successfully predicts survival outcomes based on specific mutations and chromosomal changes.

trials.title: Development and Validation of a Computational Histology Artificial Intelligence-Powered Predictive Biomarker for Selection of Chemotherapy in Advanced Pancreatic Cancer.
trials.summary: An AI-powered biomarker accurately predicts which first-line chemotherapy treatment will be most effective for patients with advanced pancreatic cancer.

trials.title: Long-Term Survivorship After Chimeric Antigen Receptor T-Cell Therapy for Hematologic Malignancies.
trials.summary: CAR T-cell therapy shows promise for treating blood cancers, but long-term survivors still face risks of infections and secondary complications requiring careful follow-up.
